prompts.wren: Create an original hand-drawn television animation character reference, in the grounded everyday-human drawing style of Rick and Morty. One single full body, front orthographic, standing upright in a strict symmetrical horizontal T-pose, palms down, with both feet, hands and fingertips comfortably inside frame. Plain clean pale ivory background and no shadow on the ground, text, borders, swatches, vignettes or reference sheet labels. Wren is a tall, warmly brown-skinned, slightly lanky adult woman with an oval head, a small forward rounded nose and two round white eyeballs with very small black pupils looking straight ahead. A gently crooked smile with closed lips. A dense, short charcoal-brown bob parting on her left tucks behind one visible ear, with slightly pointed tips at the jaw. An ordinary faded coral crew-neck t-shirt with fitted short sleeves and a clearly curved neck binding, muted teal long trousers that taper at the ankles, and low off-white canvas shoes. Modest cartoon hands with distinct fingers. Clean thin hand-inked dark lines around features, restrained warm skin shading around the ears and under the chin, and a little cool cel shading on fabric. The character's full silhouette is easy to see from crown to sole. Landscape composition with the figure large, centered and entirely visible. Make the single pictured character convincing and distinctive.
prompts.mica: Draw a single original high-quality stylized 3D cartoon sports mascot called Mica, shown straight from the front in a strict horizontal T-pose with feet together but separated and the entire figure visible. Orthographic model-sheet lighting. A perfectly round warm tangerine-orange orb head floats with a small visible gap above the round shirt collar. A ring of about fifteen lemon-yellow triangular sun rays surrounds the sphere. A single dark wraparound visor with two small painted white cross glyphs covers the eyes. No ears, nose or mouth. Small long-limbed humanoid body, thin bare orange forearms and shins, distinct cartoon hands, cream-colored loose round-collar soccer jersey with jade-green cuff bands and a simple small green diamond on its chest. Moss-green athletic shorts have two rounded hems with a small open crotch gap, calf-length ivory socks and dark slate trainers. Soft but readable studio gradients, a little occlusion at the garment seams, sculpted rays and matte colored surfaces. Plain very light neutral blue-gray background, no floor shadow, labels, text, equipment, drawings of additional poses, borders or props. Landscape canvas with fingertips, ray tips and both shoes comfortably inside the frame. Match a designer toy rather than a photoreal human.
